description:
Speak, don't type

Speak naturally, and Typeless will turn your words into polished messages, emails, and documents that read like you carefully typed them - in real time. 4x faster than typing.
Introducing Typeless Ultra

Overkill, by design.
Typeless already turns your messy thoughts into clear writing. For most people, that's more than enough. But we kept asking ourselves: how much further could we go if we pushed everything to the limit?
Ultra is our answer. Our most powerful AI. Maximum intelligence, deeper understanding, and our highest-quality writing. Every word, considered. Every detail pushed further. All so you can say what's on your mind and spend almost no time editing.
Not everyone needs Ultra. That's the point. But we built it anyway.
